summary:
P1.4c ai-scan gate needs-review (NO code committed): per the task's explicit STOP clause + design §C.4 ('先升 producer prompt → 再启门'), gating AiScanService.ts:159 opportunistically as-is would reject ~100% of ai-scan recipes (should-pass-rejected), because the ai-scan producer is a SEPARATE contract-unaware prompt living in AlembicAgent — which this task forbids touching. The fix is cross-repo and must be sequenced first.

VERIFIED BY OWN SOURCE READS (AlembicAgent read-only):
- Finding 1: ai-scan extract does NOT use the P1.4b-upgraded insightProducer. runScanAgentTask({task:'extract'}) (ScanAgentRun.ts:31) -> profile scan-extract (scan.profile.ts:19-28: basePreset insight BUT strategy pipeline scanPipeline) -> produce stage systemPrompt = the inline extract.producePrompt (scanPrompts.ts:251 wires :80-119). scanPrompts imports only buildCodeContextSection + producerRejectionGateEvaluator from insightProducer, NOT PRODUCER_SYSTEM_PROMPT/STYLE_GUIDE; the renderGuidance('in-process') upgrade (insightProducer.ts:144) is the bootstrap preset, not used by scan. => producer-prompt-first NOT in place for ai-scan.
- Finding 2: read scanPrompts.ts:80-119 verbatim — the extract prompt asks title/content.markdown/reasoning.sources/kind/trigger/doClause/whenClause but NEVER dontClause and NEVER the ✅/❌ contrast markers stage-1 requires. (summarize task :126-152 same.)
- Finding 3: the recipe reaching create is lean unnormalized LLM JSON, not the enriched item. ScanRecipe (ScanRunProjection.ts:4-13) = title?/description?/summary?/usageGuide?/category?/headers?/tags?/trigger? only; projectScanRunResult picks collected-tool recipes OR fallback-parses the produce reply as JSON (:38-97). AiScanService.ts:128-168 only mutates source/tags/moduleName/aiInsight — no authoring-field synthesis.

CONSEQUENCE: opportunistic validateAgainst before AiScanService.ts:159 => near-100% reject dominated by DONT_CLAUSE_REQUIRED + CONTENT_CONTRAST_MISSING/CONTENT_MARKDOWN_REQUIRED (and likely SOURCE_REFS_MISSING/SOURCE_REF_LINE_MISSING). That breaks `alembic ai-scan` (publishes ~0) and is the §C.4 逆向试错门 trap. NOT a bounded tightening.

CANNOT FIX IN-BOUNDARY: the producer-prompt-first fix is in AlembicAgent (scanPrompts.ts) — forbidden by this task; host-side synthesis of dontClause/✅❌/sourceRefs is fabrication (no-guess + the standing anti-auto-fix sourceRef discipline at AlembicAgent knowledge.ts:121-123); selectively disabling content gates = 放松门禁.

OPTIONS: A (recommended) sequence a producer-prompt-first upgrade to AlembicAgent FIRST (scanPrompts extract+summarize render the Core authoring contract: dontClause + ✅/❌ + sourceRefs path:line, mirroring P1.4b; ideally also reconcile the scan projection so a full-shaped recipe reaches create), THEN re-dispatch the main-body ai-scan gate (gate module is a ready §C.11 mirror) with a now-bounded new-reject set = true CG-4 closure for ai-scan. B treat AlembicAgent P1.4b as the CG-4 in-process closure and scope ai-scan OUT of this demand's CG-4 (ai-scan = CLI extract utility with a separate non-contract producer; gate it in a follow-up once its producer is contract-aware). Recommend A, producer fix FIRST; do NOT gate ai-scan before that. Full evidence + line anchors in the ledger doc.
